code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Transport document type code
definition: Code specifying the type of a document evidencing a transport contract.
code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Transport equipment license plate country code
definition: Code specifying the license plate issuing country of a trailer used as transportation equipment.

name: Transport equipment loaded status code
definition: Code specifying how full a piece of transport equipment is.

name: Transport equipment location identifier
definition: Identification of the location of the transport equipment for which the position and status of a transport equipment is being reported.

name: Transport equipment location name
definition: Name of the location of the transport equipment for which the position and status of a transport equipment is being reported.

name: Transport equipment name
definition: Registered name of the equipment used to transport the cargo.

name: Transport equipment owner name
definition: Name of the owner of the transport equipment.

name: Transport equipment status code
definition: Code specifying the status of the transport equipment.

name: Transport means at arrival identifier
definition: Identification of the means of transport at the time of arrival.
code_list:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Transport means crossing the border identifier
definition: Identification of the means of transport used in crossing the border.
code_list:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Transport means direction code
definition: Code specifying the direction of the transport means (i.e., inbound or outbound).

name: Transport means for transit identifier
definition: Identification of the means of transport used for transit.
code_list:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Transport means operation type code
definition: Code specifying the type of commercial operation of a transport means.
code_list: User code list (e.g. IATA code list)

name: Transport means operator identifier
definition: Identification of the registered operator of the means of transport.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Transport means operator name
definition: Name of the registered operator of the means of transport.

name: Transport means owner identifier
definition: Identification of the registered owner of means the of transport.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Transport means owner name
definition: Name of the registered owner of the means of transport.

name: Transport means registration location identifier
definition: Identification of the location at which a means of transport has been officially registered.

name: Transport movement code
definition: Code specifying a particular transport movement.

name: Travel agency identifier
definition: Identification of the travel agency.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Travel agency name
definition: Name of the travel agency that made the booking or reservation.

name: Travel class code
definition: Code specifying the class of travel.

name: Travel document identifier
definition: Identification of the travel document by number.

name: Travel document issue date/time
definition: Date and time the travel document was issued.

name: Travel document issuer identifier
definition: Identification of the party having issued the travel document.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Travel document issuing country or political entity
definition: Country or political entity issuing the travel document.

name: Travel document issuing country or political entity identifier
definition: Identification of the country or political entity issuing the travel document.

name: Travel document type code
definition: Code specifying the name of a travel document.
code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Travel group name
definition: Name of the travelling group.

name: Traveler status code
definition: Code specifying the status of a person on board.
code_list:
UN/EDIFACT code list 3035 
UN/EDIFACT code list 7365

name: Treatment facility provider identifier
definition: Identification of the treatment facility provider.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Treatment facility provider name
definition: Name of the treatment facility provider.

name: Type of duty regime code
definition: Code specifying a type of duty regime.
code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 9213 OR User code list

name: Type of harvesting transport means code
definition: Code specifying the type of means of transport used for harvesting.

name: Type of identification code
definition: Code specifying the type of identification used to identify a location.
code_list: User code list (see EU CDM code list for DE 16 15 046 000)

name: Type of identification of means of transport at arrival code
definition: Code specifying type of identifier of the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at arrival.
code_list: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Type of identification of means of transport at departure code
definition: Code specifying the type of identifier of the means of transport at departure.
code_list: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Type of identification of means of transport crossing the border code
definition: Code specifying type of identifier of the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
code_list: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Type of identification of passive transport means code
definition: Code specifying type of identification of passive transport means.
code_list: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Type of identification of transhipment transport means code
definition: Code specifying the type of identification of transhipment transport means.
code_list: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Type of invoice code
definition: Code specifying the type of an invoice.
code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Type of IPR code
definition: Code specifying the type of IPR according to WTO TRIPS (e.g. copyright, trademarks, geographical indication, industrial designs, patents, integrated circuits layout designs, undisclosed information and trade secrets, curbing anti-competitive licensing contracts, enforcement: tough but fair, technology transfer, etc.).
code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Type of means of transport at arrival code
definition: Code specifying means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at arrival.

name: Type of means of transport at departure code
definition: Code specifying the type of means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at departure.

name: Type of means of transport crossing the border code
definition: Code specifying type of means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.

name: Type of means of transport used for transit code
definition: Code specifying the type of means of transport used for transit.

name: Type of packages identification code
definition: Code specifying the type of package of an item.

name: UCR identifier
definition: Identification of the unique number assigned to goods being subject to cross border transactions.

name: Ultimate consignee identifier
definition: Identification of the party who has been designated on the invoice or packing list as the final recipient of the stated merchandise.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Ultimate consignee name
definition: Name of the party who has been designated on the invoice or packing list as the final recipient of the cargo.

name: United Nations Dangerous Goods (UNDG) identifier
definition: Identification of the unique serial number assigned within the United Nations to substances and articles contained in a list of the dangerous goods most commonly carried.

name: Unloading location arrival date/time
definition: Date and time of arrival at port or airport with the intent to unload.

name: Unloading location identifier
definition: Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.

name: Unloading location name
definition: Name of the unloading location, seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which the cargo is to be unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.

name: Unloading party identifier
definition: Identification of the party responsible for unloading of goods.

name: Unloading party name
definition: Name of the party responsible for unloading the goods.

name: Validity end date/time
definition: Date and time when the government agency office will no longer be operational.

name: Validity start date/time
definition: Date and time when the government agency office started to be operational.

name: Valuation additions qualifier code
definition: Code specifying the type of ˜WTO valuation agreement addition article 8: Price influence, Royalties, Assists, Proceeds, Commissions.
code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 7365 subset (codes 145, 146, 147, 148 and 149) OR User code list

name: Valuation adjustment amount
definition: Amount by which the monetary valuation was adjusted.

name: Valuation adjustment percentage
definition: Percentage adjustment made to the valuation.

name: Valuation method code
definition: Code specifying the method on which the customs value is determined.

name: Vanning date/time
definition: Date and time of loading cargo into a container.

name: Vanning party identifier
definition: Identification of the party at whose physical location the goods are loaded into the transport equipment (stuffing establishment).
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Vanning party name
definition: Name of the party at whose physical location the goods are loaded into the transport equipment (stuffing establishment).

name: Vanning proof party name
definition: Name of the authorized party responsible for certifying that the goods were loaded into the transport equipment (proof of vanning).

name: Vehicle owner identifier
definition: Identification of the owner of the vehicle.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Vehicle owner name
definition: Name of the owner of the vehicle.

name: Verifier identifier
definition: Identification of a person recognized under relevant legislation to undertake official assurance verification.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Version identifier
definition: Identification of the version of a specific document/message number.

name: Vessel bunker fuel amount
definition: Amount indicating the value of the bunker fuel laden in a vessel upon arrival at the initial port of arrival.

name: Vessel bunker fuel quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the bunker fuel on board a vessel upon arrival at the initial port of arrival.

name: Vessel bunker fuel value code
definition: Code specifying the type of fuel carried in ships bunker. Specify coal, diesel oil, or fuel oil.

name: Vessel draft level
definition: Level in meters of forward/after draft.

name: Vessel draft level aft
definition: Depth of water from the surface of water to the bottom of the vessel measured at the draft mark of the stern.

name: Vessel draft level for
definition: Depth of water from the surface of water to the bottom of the vessel measured at the draft mark of the bow.

name: Vessel length
definition: Length of single vehicle expressed in meters.

name: Veterinarian identifier
definition: Identification of the person who practices veterinary medicine.
code_list: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Veterinarian name
definition: Name of the person who practices veterinary medicine.

name: Warehouse departure date/time
definition: Date and time when declared goods were/will be carried out of the designated location.

name: Warehouse identifier
definition: Identification of a warehouse where a particular goods shipment will be / is / has been stored.
code_list: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list

name: Warehouse location name
definition: Name of the location of a warehouse where a particular goods shipment will be / is / has been stored.

name: Warehouse type code
definition: Code specifying the type of warehouse.
code_list:
UN/EDIFACT code list 3227
OR User code list

name: Warehouse type code
definition: Code specifying the role of a warehouse.
code_list:
UN/EDIFACT code list 3035
User code list

name: Waste delivery end date/time
definition: Date and time of end of waste delivery.

name: Waste delivery location identifier
definition: Identification of the location/port where waste of any type was or will be delivered.

name: Waste delivery location name
definition: Name of the location/port where waste of any type was or will be delivered.

name: Waste delivery location type code
definition: Code specifying the type of place/port where waste of any type was or will be delivered (e.g. last or next port).

name: Waste delivery start date/time
definition: Date and time of start of waste delivery.

name: Waste last delivery date/time
definition: Date and time when waste of any type was last delivered.

name: Waste type code
definition: Code specifying the type of waste being delivered.

name: WCO category code
definition: Code specifying the category within the WCO Data Model.

name: WCO Data Model version code
definition: Code specifying the version of the WCO Data Model (e.g. 3.40).

name: Write-off amount
definition: Amount to be written off a document.

name: Write-off quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the total number to be written off a document.
